Ludovico, The Sanguine Steward: Serving Protection and Pints
Ludovico is a 5-star Legendary Ice hero from the
(Flower of Blood) family, introduced during the Sanguine Feast seasonal event in late 2025. As a
, he fills a vital support role that the Ice element has historically lacked in abundance: a reliable, high-speed cleanser and healer.

While his appearance might suggest he's just there to top off your glass, Ludovico is a direct response to the fiend-heavy "Vegetable" meta that dominated the latter half of 2025. He doesn't just heal; he ensures your team stays clean and fiend-free.

Ludovico embraces the "vampire nobility service staff" aesthetic with gusto. He looks like the kind of guy who would apologize profusely while draining your blood, insisting it's for a "delightful reduction sauce." He carries a tray of suspiciously red drinks and a large pitcher, looking every bit the dutiful, if slightly unnerving, steward. The art style fits perfectly with the gothic, slightly campy horror vibe of the Morlovia and Sanguine themes. It is a nice change of pace to see a hero who is essentially a waiter rather than another armored warrior screaming at the sky.

Released in late 2025, Ludovico was part of the wave of heroes designed to counter the "Vegetable" family and other heavy Fiend summoners.

His stats are modern but not top-of-the-chart broken. His value lies entirely in his utility. Fast Cleanse + Fiend Block is a combination that ages very well (just look at how long Garnet stayed relevant).

He is arguably the best hero from his batch because support skills like his are timeless. While damage dealers get outclassed by bigger numbers next month, a Fast Cleanse/Blocker is always useful in War and Tournaments.
